title: Relative distance under matrix unflattening
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f,g$ be functions from the $n\times n$ matrices over the two-element field to that field. Regard each binary matrix as its array of $n^2$ entries in a fixed coordinate order. The relative Hamming distance between the resulting functions on binary arrays equals the relative Hamming distance between $f$ and $g$ on matrices.
hypotheses_covered: f and g are functions from n-by-n matrices over the two-element field to that field
